verses.en: The book of the generation of Yahushua the Messiah, the son of Dawid, the son of Abraham.
verses.am: የዳዊት ልጅ የአብርሃም ልጅ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ትውልድ መጽሐፍ።

verses.en: Abraham begat Yitschaq; and Yitschaq begat Ya'aqob; and Ya'aqob begat Judas and his brethren;
verses.am: አብርሃም ይስሐቅን ወለደ፤ ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ወለደ፤ ያዕቆብም ይሁዳንና ወንድሞቹን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
verses.am: ይሁዳም ከትዕማር ፋሬስንና ዛራን ወለደ፤ ፋሬስም ኤስሮምን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
verses.am: ኤስሮምም አራምን ወለደ፤ አራምም አሚናዳብን ወለደ፤ አሚናዳብም ነአሶንን ወለደ፤ ነአሶንም ሰልሞንን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
verses.am: ሰልሞንም ከራኬብ ቦኤዝን ወለደ፤ ቦኤዝም ከሩት ኢዮቤድን ወለደ፤ ኢዮቤድም እሴይን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Jesse begat Dawid the king; and Dawid the king begat Shelomoh of her that had been the wife of Urias;
verses.am: እሴይም ንጉሥ ዳዊትን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Shelomoh begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ሮብዓምን ወለደ፤ ሮብዓምም አቢያን ወለደ፤ አቢያም አሣፍን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
verses.am: አሣፍም ኢዮሣፍጥን ወለደ፤ ኢዮሣፍጥም ኢዮራምን ወለደ፤ ኢዮራምም ዖዝያንን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
verses.am: ዖዝያንም ኢዮአታምን ወለደ፤ ኢዮአታምም አካዝን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
verses.am: አካዝም ሕዝቅያስን ወለደ፤ ሕዝቅያስም ምናሴን ወለደ፤ ምናሴም አሞፅን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babel:
verses.am: አሞፅም ኢዮስያስን ወለደ፤ ኢዮስያስም በባቢሎን ምርኮ ጊዜ ኢኮንያንንና ወንድሞቹን ወለደ።

verses.en: And after they were brought to Babel, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
verses.am: ከባቢሎንም ምርኮ በኋላ ኢኮንያን ሰላትያልን ወለደ፤ ሰላትያልም ዘሩባቤልን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
verses.am: ዘሩባቤልም አብዩድን ወለደ፤ አብዩድም ኤልያቄምን ወለደ፤ ኤልያቄምም አዛርን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
verses.am: አዛርም ሳዶቅን ወለደ፤ ሳዶቅም አኪምን ወለደ፤ አኪምም ኤልዩድን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Ya'aqob;
verses.am: ኤልዩድም አልዓዛርን ወለደ፤ አልዓዛርም ማታንን ወለደ፤ ማታንም ያዕቆብን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Ya'aqob begat Yoseph the husband of Miryam, of whom was born Yahushua, who is called Messiah.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ክርስቶስ የተባለውን ኢየሱስን የወለደች የማርያምን እጮኛ ዮሴፍን ወለደ።

verses.en: So all the generations from Abraham to Dawid are fourteen generations; and from Dawid until the carrying away into Babel are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babel unto Messiah are fourteen generations.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ትውልድ ሁሉ ከአብርሃም እስከ ዳዊት አሥራ አራት ትውልድ፥ ከዳዊትም እስከ ባቢሎን ምርኮ አሥራ አራት ትውልድ፥ ከባቢሎንም ምርኮ እስከ ክርስቶስ አሥራ አራት ትውልድ ነው።

verses.en: Now the birth of Yahushua the Messiah was on this wise: When as his mother Miryam was espoused to Yoseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Set-apart Spirit.
verses.am: የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ልደት እንዲህ ነበረ። እናቱ ማርያም ለዮሴፍ በታጨች ጊዜ ሳይገናኙ ከመንፈስ ቅዱስ ፀንሳ ተገኘች።

verses.en: Then Yoseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
verses.am: እጮኛዋ ዮሴፍም ጻድቅ ሆኖ ሊገልጣት ስላልወደደ በስውር ሊተዋት አሰበ።

verses.en: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Master appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Yoseph, thou son of Dawid, fear not to take unto thee Miryam thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Set-apart Spirit.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ይህን ሲያስብ፥ እነሆ የጌታ መልአክ በሕልም ታየው፥ እንዲህም አለ። የዳዊት ልጅ ዮሴፍ ሆይ፥ ከእርስዋ የተፀነሰው ከመንፈስ ቅዱስ ነውና እጮኛህን ማርያምን ለመውሰድ አትፍራ።

verses.en: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Yahushua: for he shall save his people from their sins.
verses.am: ልጅም ትወልዳለች፤ እርሱ ሕዝቡን ከኃጢአታቸው ያድናቸዋልና ስሙን ኢየሱስ ትለዋለህ።

verses.en: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Master by the prophet, saying,
verses.am: በነቢይ ከጌታ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, YAHUAH with us.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ድንግል ትፀንሳለች ልጅም ትወልዳለች፥ ስሙንም አማኑኤል ይሉታል የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሁሉ ሆኖአል፥ ትርጓሜውም። እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር የሚል ነው።

verses.en: Then Yoseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Master had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ከእንቅልፉ ነቅቶ የጌታ መልአክ እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ እጮኛውንም ወሰደ፤

verses.en: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name Yahushua.
verses.am: የበኩር ልጅዋንም እስክትወልድ ድረስ አላወቃትም፤ ስሙንም ኢየሱስ አለው።

verses.en: Now when Yahushua was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Yerushalayim,
Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Yehudim? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በይሁዳ ቤተ ልሔም በንጉሡ በሄሮድስ ዘመን በተወለደ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰብአ ሰገል። የተወለደው የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ወዴት ነው? ኮከቡን በምሥራቅ አይተን ልንሰግድለት መጥተናልና እያሉ ከምሥራቅ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.en: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Yerushalayim with him.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ሄሮድስም ሰምቶ ደነገጠ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር፤

verses.en: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Messiah should be born.
verses.am: የካህናትንም አለቆች የሕዝቡንም ጻፎች ሁሉ ሰብስቦ ክርስቶስ ወዴት እንዲወለድ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Yisra'el.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አንቺ ቤተ ልሔም፥ የይሁዳ ምድር፥ ከይሁዳ ገዢዎች ከቶ አታንሽም፤ ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን የሚጠብቅ መስፍን ከአንቺ ይወጣልና ተብሎ በነቢይ እንዲህ ተጽፎአልና በይሁዳ ቤተ ልሔም ነው አሉት።

verses.en: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገልን በስውር ጠርቶ ኮከቡ የታየበትን ዘመን ከእነርሱ በጥንቃቄ ተረዳ፥

verses.en: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
verses.am: ወደ ቤተ ልሔምም እነርሱን ሰድዶ። ሂዱ፥ ስለ ሕፃኑ በጥንቃቄ መርምሩ፤ ባገኛችሁትም ጊዜ እኔ ደግሞ መጥቼ እንድሰግድለት ንገሩኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
verses.am: እነርሱም ንጉሡን ሰምተው ሄዱ፤ እነሆም፥ በምሥራቅ ያዩት ኮከብ ሕፃኑ ባለበት ላይ መጥቶ እስኪቆም ድረስ ይመራቸው ነበር።

verses.en: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
verses.am: ኮከቡንም ባዩ ጊዜ በታላቅ ደስታ እጅግ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Miryam his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም ገብተው ሕፃኑን ከእናቱ ከማርያም ጋር አዩት፥ ወድቀውም ሰገዱለት፥ ሣጥኖቻቸውንም ከፍተው እጅ መንሻ ወርቅና ዕጣን ከርቤም አቀረቡለት።

verses.en: And being warned of YAHUAH in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
verses.am: ወደ ሄሮድስም እንዳይመለሱ በሕልም ተረድተው በሌላ መንገድ ወደ አገራቸው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Master appeareth to Yoseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Mitsrayim, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከሄዱ በኋላ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በሕልም ለዮሴፍ ታይቶ። ሄሮድስ ሕፃኑን ሊገድለው ይፈልገዋልና ተነሣ፥ ሕፃኑንና እናቱንም ይዘህ ወደ ግብፅ ሽሽ፥ እስክነግርህም ድረስ በዚያ ተቀመጥ አለው።

verses.en: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Mitsrayim:
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተሣለቁበት ባየ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቆጣና ልኮ ከሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተረዳው ዘመን በቤተ ልሔምና በአውራጃዋ የነበሩትን፥ ሁለት ዓመት የሆናቸውን ከዚያም የሚያንሱትን ሕፃናት ሁሉ አስገደለ።

verses.en: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Master by the prophet, saying, Out of Mitsrayim have I called my son.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተሣለቁበት ባየ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቆጣና ልኮ ከሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተረዳው ዘመን በቤተ ልሔምና በአውራጃዋ የነበሩትን፥ ሁለት ዓመት የሆናቸውን ከዚያም የሚያንሱትን ሕፃናት ሁሉ አስገደለ።

verses.en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ከሞተ በኋላ፥ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በግብፅ ለዮሴፍ በሕልም ታይቶ።

verses.en: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ከሞተ በኋላ፥ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በግብፅ ለዮሴፍ በሕልም ታይቶ።

verses.en: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Master appeareth in a dream to Yoseph in Mitsrayim,
verses.am: የሕፃኑን ነፍስ የፈለጉት ሞተዋልና ተነሣ፥ ሕፃኑን እናቱንም ይዘህ ወደ እስራኤል አገር ሂድ አለ።

verses.en: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Yisra'el: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
verses.am: እርሱም ተነሥቶ ሕፃኑንና እናቱን ያዘና ወደ እስራኤል አገር ገባ።

verses.en: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Yisra'el.
verses.am: በአባቱም በሄሮድስ ፈንታ አርኬላዎስ በይሁዳ እንደ ነገሠ በሰማ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚያ መሄድን ፈራ፤ በሕልምም ተረድቶ ወደ ገሊላ አገር ሄደ፤

verses.en: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of YAHUAH in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
verses.am: በነቢያት። ናዝራዊ ይባላል የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ፥ ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ከተማ መጥቶ ኖረ።

verses.en: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
In those days came Yohanan the Immerser, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት

verses.en: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.am: ቀርባለችና ንስሐ ግቡ ብሎ በይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ እየሰበከ መጣ።

verses.en: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Master, make his paths straight.
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮህ ሰው ድምፅ የተባለለት ይህ ነውና።

verses.en: And the same Yohanan had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
verses.am: ራሱም ዮሐንስ የግመል ጠጉር ልብስ ነበረው፥ በወገቡም ጠፍር ይታጠቅ ነበር፤ ምግቡም አንበጣና የበረሀ ማር ነበረ።

verses.en: Then went out to him Yerushalayim, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሁዳም ሁሉ በዮርዳኖስም ዙሪያ ያለ አገር ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይወጡ ነበር፤

verses.en: And were immersed of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.am: ኃጢአታቸውንም እየተናዘዙ በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ከእርሱ ይጠመቁ ነበር።

verses.en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his immersion, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን ብዙዎች ወደ ጥምቀቱ ሲመጡ ባየ ጊዜ፥ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከሚመጣው ቍጣ እንድትሸሹ ማን አመለከታችሁ?

verses.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
verses.am: እንግዲህ ለንስሐ የሚገባ ፍሬ አድርጉ፤

verses.en: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that YAHUAH is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.am: በልባችሁም። አብርሃም አባት አለን እንደምትሉ አይምሰላችሁ፤ እላችኋለሁና። ከነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆች ሊያስነሣለት እግዚአብሔር ይችላል።

verses.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.am: አሁንስ ምሳር በዛፎች ሥር ተቀምጦአል፤ እንግዲህ መልካም ፍሬ የማያደርግ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቈረጣል ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

verses.en: I indeed immerse you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall immerse you with the Set-apart Spirit, and with fire:
verses.am: እኔስ ለንስሐ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ፤ ጫማውን እሸከም ዘንድ የማይገባኝ ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ግን ከእኔ ይልቅ ይበረታል፤ እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ በእሳትም ያጠምቃችኋል፤

verses.en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
verses.am: መንሹም በእጁ ነው፥ አውድማውንም ፈጽሞ ያጠራል፥ ስንዴውንም በጎተራው ይከታል፥ ገለባውን ግን በማይጠፋ እሳት ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: Then cometh Yahushua from Galilee to Jordan unto Yohanan, to be immersed of him.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በዮሐንስ ሊጠመቅ ከገሊላ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መጣ።

verses.en: But Yohanan forbad him, saying, I have need to be immersed of thee, and comest thou to me?
verses.am: ዮሐንስ ግን። እኔ በአንተ ልጠመቅ ያስፈልገኛል አንተም ወደ እኔ ትመጣለህን? ብሎ ይከለክለው ነበር።

verses.en: And Yahushua answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። አሁንስ ፍቀድልኝ፤ እንዲህ ጽድቅን ሁሉ መፈጸም ይገባናልና አለው። ያን ጊዜ ፈቀደለት።

verses.en: And Yahushua, when he was immersed, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of YAHUAH descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከተጠመቀ በኋላ ወዲያው ከውኃ ወጣ፤ እነሆም፥ ሰማያት ተከፈቱ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ ሲወርድ በእርሱ ላይም ሲመጣ አየ፤

verses.en: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ድምፅ ከሰማያት መጥቶ። በእርሱ ደስ የሚለኝ የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው አለ።

verses.en: Then was Yahushua led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያ ኢየሱስ ከዲያብሎስ ይፈተን ዘንድ መንፈስ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወሰደው፥

verses.en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
verses.am: አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊትም ከጦመ በኋላ ተራበ።

verses.en: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of YAHUAH, command that these stones be made bread.
verses.am: ፈታኝም ቀርቦ። የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ከሆንህ፥ እነዚህ ድንጋዮች እንጀራ እንዲሆኑ በል አለው።

verses.en: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። ሰው ከእግዚአብሔር አፍ በሚወጣ ቃል ሁሉ እንጂ በእንጀራ ብቻ አይኖርም ተብሎ ተጽፎአል አለው።

verses.en: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ዲያቢሎስ ወደ ቅድስት ከተማ ወሰደውና እርሱን በመቅደስ ጫፍ ላይ አቁሞ።

verses.en: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of YAHUAH, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.am: መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝልሃል እግርህንም በድንጋይ ከቶ እንዳትሰናከል በእጃቸው ያነሡሃል ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ፥ ወደ ታች ራስህን ወርውር አለው።

verses.en: Yahushua said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Master thy YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ጌታን አምላክህን አትፈታተነው ተብሎ ደግሞ ተጽፎአል አለው።

verses.en: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
verses.am: ደግሞ ዲያቢሎስ እጅግ ረጅም ወደ ሆነ ተራራ ወሰደው፥ የዓለምንም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ክብራቸውንም አሳይቶ።

verses.en: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
verses.am: ወድቀህ ብትሰግድልኝ ይህን ሁሉ እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then saith Yahushua unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Master thy YAHUAH, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። ሂድ፥ አንተ ሰይጣን ለጌታህ ለአምላክህ ስገድ እርሱንም ብቻ አምልክ ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና አለው።

verses.en: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ዲያቢሎስ ተወው፥ እነሆም፥ መላእክት ቀርበው ያገለግሉት ነበር።

verses.en: Now when Yahushua had heard that Yohanan was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዮሐንስ አልፎ እንደ ተሰጠ በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ገሊላ ፈቀቅ ብሎ ሄደ።

verses.en: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
verses.am: ናዝሬትንም ትቶ በዛብሎንና በንፍታሌም አገር በባሕር አጠገብ ወደ አለችው ወደ ቅፍርናሆም መጥቶ ኖረ።

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the nations;
The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
verses.am: በነቢዩም በኢሳይያስ። የዛብሎን ምድርና የንፍታሌም ምድር፥ የባሕር መንገድ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ፥ የአሕዛብ ገሊላ፤ በጨለማ የተቀመጠው ሕዝብ ታላቅ ብርሃን አየ፥ በሞት አገርና ጥላ ለተቀመጡትም ብርሃን ወጣላቸው

verses.en: From that time Yahushua began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.am: የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ። ከዚያ ዘመን ጀምሮ ኢየሱስ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለችና ንስሐ ግቡ እያለ ይሰብክ ጀመር።

verses.en: And Yahushua, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Kepha, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.am: በገሊላ ባሕር አጠገብ ሲመላለስም ሁለት ወንድማማች ጴጥሮስ የሚሉትን ስምዖንን ወንድሙንም እንድርያስን መረባቸውን ወደ ባሕር ሲጥሉ አየ፥ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ነበሩና።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verses.am: እርሱም። በኋላዬ ኑና ሰዎችን አጥማጆች እንድትሆኑ አደርጋችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
verses.am: ወዲያውም መረባቸውን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, Ya'aqob the son of Zebedee, and Yohanan his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
verses.am: ከዚያም እልፍ ብሎ ሌሎችን ሁለት ወንድማማች የዘብዴዎስን ልጅ ያዕቆብን ወንድሙንም ዮሐንስን ከአባታቸው ከዘብዴዎስ ጋር በታንኳ መረባቸውን ሲያበጁ አየ፤ ጠራቸውም።

verses.en: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወዲያው ታንኳይቱንና አባታቸውን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And Yahushua went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በምኩራቦቻቸው እያስተማረ የመንግሥትንም ወንጌል እየሰበከ በሕዝብም ያለውን ደዌና ሕማም ሁሉ እየፈወሰ በገሊላ ሁሉ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.en: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
verses.am: ዝናውም ወደ ሶርያ ሁሉ ወጣ፤ በልዩ ልዩ ደዌና ሥቃይም ተይዘው የታመሙትን ሁሉ አጋንንትም ያደሩባቸውን በጨረቃም የሚነሣባቸውን ሽባዎችንም ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፥ ፈወሳቸውም።

verses.en: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Yerushalayim, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
verses.am: ከገሊላም ከአሥሩ ከተማም ከኢየሩሳሌምም ከይሁዳም ከዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም አይቶ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ፤ በተቀመጠም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፤

verses.en: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
verses.am: አፉንም ከፍቶ አስተማራቸው እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.am: በመንፈስ ድሆች የሆኑ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናትና።
verses.gez: ብፁዓን መናኒ መንፈስ እስመ እሙንቱ ይረክቡ መንግሥተ ሰማያት።

verses.en: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.am: የሚያዝኑ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መፅናናትን ያገኛሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.am: የዋሆች ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ ምድርን ይወርሳሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.am: ጽድቅን የሚራቡና የሚጠሙ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ ይጠግባሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.am: የሚምሩ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ ይማራሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see YAHUAH.
verses.am: ልበ ንጹሖች ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርን ያዩታልና።

verses.en: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሚያስተራርቁ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ይባላሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.am: ስለ ጽድቅ የሚሰደዱ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናትና።

verses.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.am: ሲነቅፉአችሁና ሲያሳድዱአችሁ በእኔም ምክንያት ክፉውን ሁሉ በውሸት ሲናገሩባችሁ ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.en: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.am: ዋጋችሁ በሰማያት ታላቅ ነውና ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ሐሴትም አድርጉ፤ ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩትን ነቢያትን እንዲሁ አሳድደዋቸዋልና።

verses.en: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.am: እናንተ የምድር ጨው ናችሁ፤ ጨው አልጫ ቢሆን ግን በምን ይጣፍጣል? ወደ ውጭ ተጥሎ በሰው ከመረገጥ በቀር ወደ ፊት ለምንም አይጠቅምም።

verses.en: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.am: እናንተ የዓለም ብርሃን ናችሁ። በተራራ ላይ ያለች ከተማ ልትሰወር አይቻላትም።

verses.en: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verses.am: መብራትንም አብርተው ከዕንቅብ በታች አይደለም እንጂ በመቅረዙ ላይ ያኖሩታል በቤት ላሉት ሁሉም ያበራል።

verses.en: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.am: መልካሙን ሥራችሁን አይተው በሰማያት ያለውን አባታችሁን እንዲያከብሩ ብርሃናችሁ እንዲሁ በሰው ፊት ይብራ።

verses.en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verses.am: እኔ ሕግንና ነቢያትን ለመሻር የመጣሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ ልፈጽም እንጂ ለመሻር አልመጣሁም።

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰማይና ምድር እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ ከሕግ አንዲት የውጣ ወይም አንዲት ነጥብ ከቶ አታልፍም፥ ሁሉ እስኪፈጸም ድረስ።

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከነዚህ ከሁሉ ካነሱት ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን የሚሽር ለሰውም እንዲሁ የሚያስተምር ማንም ሰው በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ከሁሉ ታናሽ ይባላል፤ የሚያደርግ ግን የሚያስተምርም ማንም ቢሆን እርሱ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ታላቅ ይባላል።

verses.en: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁና። ጽድቃችሁ ከጻፎችና ከፈሪሳውያን ጽድቅ ካልበለጠ፥ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ከቶ አትገቡም።

verses.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.am: ለቀደሙት። አትግደል እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል፤ የገደለም ሁሉ ፍርድ ይገባዋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በወንድሙ ላይ የሚቆጣ ሁሉ ፍርድ ይገባዋል፤ ወንድሙንም ጨርቃም የሚለው ሁሉ የሸንጎ ፍርድ ይገባዋል፤ ደንቆሮ የሚለውም ሁሉ የገሃነመ እሳት ፍርድ ይገባዋል።

verses.en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
verses.am: እንግዲህ መባህን በመሠዊያው ላይ ብታቀርብ፥ በዚያም ወንድምህ አንዳች በአንተ ላይ እንዳለው ብታስብ፥

verses.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
verses.am: በዚያ በመሠዊያው ፊት መባህን ትተህ ሂድ፥ አስቀድመህም ከወንድምህ ጋር ታረቅ፥ በኋላም መጥተህ መባህን አቅርብ።

verses.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
verses.am: አብረኸው በመንገድ ሳለህ ከባላጋራህ ጋር ፈጥነህ ተስማማ፤ ባላጋራ ለዳኛ እንዳይሰጥህ ዳኛም ለሎሌው፥ ወደ ወህኒም ትጣላለህ፤

verses.en: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
verses.am: እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ የመጨረሻዋን ሳንቲም እስክትከፍል ድረስ ከቶ ከዚያ አትወጣም።

verses.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
verses.am: አታመንዝር እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ወደ ሴት ያየ ሁሉ የተመኛትም ያን ጊዜ በልቡ ከእርስዋ ጋር አመንዝሮአል።

verses.en: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.am: ቀኝ ዓይንህም ብታሰናክልህ አውጥተህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሙሉ ሰውነትህ በገሃነም ከሚጣል ይልቅ ከአካላትህ አንድ ቢጠፋ ይሻልሃልና።

verses.en: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.am: ቀኝ እጅህም ብታሰናክልህ ቆርጠህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሙሉ ሰውነትህ በገሃነም ከሚጣል ይልቅ ከአካላትህ አንድ ቢጠፋ ይሻላልና።

verses.en: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.am: ሚስቱን የሚፈታት ሁሉ የፍችዋን ጽሕፈት ይስጣት ተባለ።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ያለ ዝሙት ምክንያት ሚስቱን የሚፈታ ሁሉ አመንዝራ ያደርጋታል፥ የተፈታችውንም የሚያገባ ሁሉ ያመነዝራል።

verses.en: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Master thine oaths:
verses.am: ደግሞ ለቀደሙት። በውሸት አትማል ነገር ግን መሐላዎችህን ለጌታ ስጥ እንደተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is YAHUAH's throne:
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ። ከቶ አትማሉ፤ በሰማይ አይሆንም የእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ነውና፤

verses.en: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Yerushalayim; for it is the city of the great King.
verses.am: በምድርም አይሆንም የእግሩ መረገጫ ናትና፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አይሆንም የታላቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ ናትና፤

verses.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
verses.am: በራስህም አትማል፥ አንዲቱን ጠጉር ነጭ ወይም ጥቁር ልታደርግ አትችልምና።

verses.en: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ቃላችሁ አዎን አዎን ወይም አይደለም አይደለም ይሁን፤ ከነዚህም የወጣ ከክፉው ነው።

verses.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.am: ዓይን ስለ ዓይን ጥርስም ስለ ጥርስ እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ክፉውን አትቃወሙ፤ ዳሩ ግን ቀኝ ጉንጭህን በጥፊ ለሚመታህ ሁሉ ሁለተኛውን ደግሞ አዙርለት፤

verses.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.
verses.am: እንዲከስህም እጀ ጠባብህንም እንዲወስድ ለሚወድ መጎናጸፊያህን ደግሞ ተውለት፤

verses.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.am: ማንም ሰው አንድ ምዕራፍ ትሄድ ዘንድ ቢያስገድድህ ሁለተኛውን ከእርሱ ጋር ሂድ።

verses.en: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
verses.am: ለሚለምንህ ስጥ፥ ከአንተም ይበደር ዘንድ ከሚወደው ፈቀቅ አትበል።

verses.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
verses.am: ባልንጀራህን ውደድ ጠላትህንም ጥላ እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verses.am: የሚወዱአችሁን ብትወዱ ምን ዋጋ አላችሁ? ቀራጮችስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?

verses.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.am: የሚወዱአችሁን ብትወዱ ምን ዋጋ አላችሁ? ቀራጮችስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?

verses.en: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.am: ወንድሞቻችሁንም ብቻ እጅ ብትነሡ ምን ብልጫ ታደርጋላችሁ? አሕዛብስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?

verses.en: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
verses.am: እንግዲህ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ ፍጹም እንደ ሆነ እናንተ ፍጹማን ሁኑ።

verses.en: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
verses.am: ለሰዎች ትታዩ ዘንድ ምጽዋታችሁን በፊታቸው እንዳታደርጉ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ያለዚያ በሰማያት ባለው አባታችሁ ዘንድ ዋጋ የላችሁም።

verses.en: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምጽዋት ስታደርግ፥ ግብዞች በሰው ዘንድ ሊከበሩ በምኩራብ በመንገድም እንደሚያደርጉ በፊትህ መለከት አታስነፋ፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.en: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ምጽዋት ስታደርግ ምጽዋትህ በስውር እንዲሆን ቀኝህ የምትሠራውን ግራህ አትወቅ፤ በስውር የሚያይ አባትህም በግልጥ ይከፍልሃል።

verses.en: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.am: ስትጸልዩም እንደ ግብዞች አትሁኑ፤ ለሰው ይታዩ ዘንድ በምኩራብና በመንገድ ማዕዘን ቆመው መጸለይን ይወዳሉና፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.en: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ስትጸልይ፥ ወደ እልፍኝህ ግባ መዝጊያህንም ዘግተህ በስውር ላለው አባትህ ጸልይ፤ በስውር የሚያይ አባትህም በግልጥ ይከፍልሃል።

verses.en: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verses.am: አሕዛብም በመናገራቸው ብዛት እንዲሰሙ ይመስላቸዋልና ስትጸልዩ እንደ እነርሱ በከንቱ አትድገሙ።

verses.en: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አትምሰሉአቸው፤ ሳትለምኑት አባታችሁ የሚያስፈልጋችሁን ያውቃልና።

verses.en: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እናንተስ እንዲህ ጸልዩ። በሰማያት የምትኖር አባታችን ሆይ፥

verses.en: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
verses.am: ስምህ ይቀደስ፤ መንግሥትህ ትምጣ፤ ፈቃድህ በሰማይ እንደ ሆነች እንዲሁ በምድር ትሁን፤

verses.en: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.am: የዕለት እንጀራችንን ዛሬ ስጠን፤

verses.en: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
verses.am: እኛም ደግሞ የበደሉንን ይቅር እንደምንል በደላችንን ይቅር በለን፤

verses.en: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verses.am: ከክፉም አድነን እንጂ ወደ ፈተና አታግባን፤ መንግሥት ያንተ ናትና ኃይልም ክብርም ለዘለዓለሙ፤ አሜን።

verses.en: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
verses.am: ለሰዎች ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር ብትሉ፥ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ እናንተን ደግሞ ይቅር ይላችኋልና፤

verses.en: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.am: ለሰዎች ግን ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር ባትሉ፥ አባታችሁም ኃጢአታችሁን ይቅር አይላችሁም።

verses.en: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.am: ስትጦሙም፥ እንደ ግብዞች አትጠውልጉ፤ ለሰዎች እንደ ጦመኛ ሊታዩ ፊታቸውን ያጠፋሉና፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.en: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
verses.am: ብልና ዝገት በሚያጠፉት ሌቦችም ቆፍረው በሚሠርቁት ዘንድ ለእናንተ በምድር ላይ መዝገብ አትሰብስቡ፤

verses.en: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
verses.am: ብልና ዝገት በሚያጠፉት ሌቦችም ቆፍረው በሚሠርቁት ዘንድ ለእናንተ በምድር ላይ መዝገብ አትሰብስቡ፤

verses.en: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
verses.am: ነገር ግን ብልም ዝገትም በማያጠፉት ሌቦችም ቆፍረው በማይሠርቁት ዘንድ ለእናንተ በሰማይ መዝገብ ሰብስቡ፤

verses.en: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
verses.am: መዝገብህ ባለበት ልብህ ደግሞ በዚያ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.am: የሰውነት መብራት ዓይን ናት። ዓይንህ እንግዲህ ጤናማ ብትሆን፥ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ ብሩህ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
verses.am: ዓይንህ ግን ታማሚ ብትሆን፥ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ የጨለመ ይሆናል። እንግዲህ በአንተ ያለው ብርሃን ጨለማ ከሆነ፥ ጨለማውስ እንዴት ይበረታ!

verses.en: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
verses.am: ለሁለት ጌቶች መገዛት የሚቻለው ማንም የለም፤ ወይም አንዱን ይጠላል ሁለተኛውንም ይወዳል፤ ወይም ወደ አንዱ ይጠጋል ሁለተኛውንም ይንቃል፤ ለእግዚአብሔርና ለገንዘብ መገዛት አትችሉም።

verses.en: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve YAHUAH and mammon.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ ነፍሳችሁ በምትበሉትና በምትጠጡት፥ ወይም ስለ ሰውነታችሁ በምትለብሱት አትጨነቁ፤ ነፍስ ከመብል ሰውነትም ከልብስ አይበልጥምን?

verses.en: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
verses.am: ወደ ሰማይ ወፎች ተመልከቱ፤ አይዘሩም አያጭዱምም በጎተራም አይከቱም፥ የሰማዩ አባታችሁም ይመግባቸዋል፤ እናንተ ከእነርሱ እጅግ አትበልጡምን?

verses.en: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
verses.am: ከእናንተ ተጨንቆ በቁመቱ ላይ አንድ ክንድ መጨመር የሚችል ማን ነው?

verses.en: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
verses.am: ስለ ልብስስ ስለ ምን ትጨነቃላችሁ? የሜዳ አበቦች እንዴት እንዲያድጉ ልብ አድርጋችሁ ተመልከቱ፤

verses.en: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
verses.am: አይደክሙም አይፈትሉምም፤ ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰሎሞንስ እንኳ በክብሩ ሁሉ ከነዚህ እንደ አንዱ አልለበሰም።

verses.en: And yet I say unto you, That even Shelomoh in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ዛሬ ያለውን ነገም ወደ እቶን የሚጣለውን የሜዳን ሣር እንዲህ የሚያለብሰው ከሆነ፥ እናንተ እምነት የጎደላችሁ፥ እናንተንማ ይልቁን እንዴት?

verses.en: Wherefore, if YAHUAH so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
verses.am: እንግዲህ። ምን እንበላለን? ምንስ እንጠጣለን? ምንስ እንለብሳለን? ብላችሁ አትጨነቁ፤

verses.en: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
verses.am: ይህንስ ሁሉ አሕዛብ ይፈልጋሉ፤ ይህ ሁሉ እንዲያስፈልጋችሁ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ ያውቃልና።

verses.en: (For after all these things do the nations seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አስቀድማችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ጽድቁንም ፈልጉ፥ ይህም ሁሉ ይጨመርላችኋል።

verses.en: But seek ye first the kingdom of YAHUAH, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.am: ነገ ለራሱ ይጨነቃልና ለነገ አትጨነቁ፤ ለቀኑ ክፋቱ ይበቃዋል።

verses.en: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
Judge not, that ye be not judged.
verses.am: እንዳይፈረድባችሁ አትፍረዱ፤

verses.en: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
verses.am: በምትፈርዱበት ፍርድ ይፈረድባችኋልና፥ በምትሰፍሩበትም መስፈሪያ ይሰፈርባችኋል።

verses.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.am: በወንድምህም ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ስለምን ታያለህ፥ በዓይንህ ግን ያለውን ምሰሶ ስለ ምን አትመለከትም?

verses.en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
verses.am: ወይም ወንድምህን። ከዓይንህ ጉድፍ ላውጣ ፍቀድልኝ እንዴትስ ትለዋለህ? እነሆም፥ በዓይንህ ምሰሶ አለ።

verses.en: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
verses.am: አንተ ግብዝ፥ አስቀድመህ ከዓይንህ ምሰሶውን አውጣ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ከወንድምህ ዓይን ጉድፉን ታወጣ ዘንድ አጥርተህ ታያለህ።

verses.en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verses.am: በእግራቸው እንዳይረግጡት ተመልሰውም እንዳይነክሱአችሁ፥ የተቀደሰውን ለውሾች አትስጡ፥ ዕንቁዎቻችሁንም በእሪያዎች ፊት አትጣሉ።

verses.en: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.am: ለምኑ፥ ይሰጣችሁማል፤ ፈልጉ፥ ታገኙማላችሁ፤ መዝጊያን አንኳኩ፥ ይከፈትላችሁማል።

verses.en: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.am: የሚለምነው ሁሉ ይቀበላልና፥ የሚፈልገውም ያገኛል፥ መዝጊያንም ለሚያንኳኳ ይከፈትለታል።

verses.en: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
verses.am: ወይስ ከእናንተ፥ ልጁ እንጀራ ቢለምነው፥ ድንጋይን የሚሰጠው ከእናንተ ማን ሰው ነው?

verses.en: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
verses.am: ዓሣስ ቢለምነው እባብን ይሰጠዋልን?

verses.en: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verses.am: እንኪያስ እናንተ ክፉዎች ስትሆኑ ለልጆቻችሁ መልካም ስጦታ መስጠትን ካወቃችሁ፥ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁ ለሚለምኑት እንዴት አብልጦ መልካም ነገርን ይሰጣቸው?

verses.en: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሰዎች ሊያደርጉላችሁ የምትወዱትን ሁሉ እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው፤ ሕግም ነቢያትም ይህ ነውና።

verses.en: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
verses.am: በጠበበው ደጅ ግቡ፤ ወደ ጥፋት የሚወስደው ደጅ ሰፊ፥ መንገዱም ትልቅ ነውና፥ ወደ እርሱም የሚገቡ ብዙዎች ናቸው፤

verses.en: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
verses.am: ወደ ሕይወት የሚወስደው ደጅ የጠበበ፥ መንገዱም የቀጠነ ነውና፥ የሚያገኙትም ጥቂቶች ናቸው።

verses.en: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
verses.am: የበግ ለምድ ለብሰው ከሚመጡባችሁ በውሥጣቸው ግን ነጣቂዎች ተኵላዎች ከሆኑ ከሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verses.am: ከፍሬያቸው ታውቋቸዋላችሁ። ከእሾህ ወይን ከኩርንችትስ በለስ ይለቀማልን?

verses.en: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
verses.am: እንዲሁ መልካም ዛፍ ሁሉ መልካም ፍሬ ያደርጋል፥ ክፉም ዛፍ ክፉ ፍሬ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.am: መልካም ዛፍ ክፉ ፍሬ ማፍራት፥ ወይም ክፉ ዛፍ መልካም ፍሬ ማፍራት አይቻለውም።

verses.en: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.am: መልካም ፍሬ የማያደርግ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

verses.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ከፍሬያቸው ታውቋቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: Not every one that saith unto me, Master, Master, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.am: በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ እንጂ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ የሚለኝ ሁሉ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የሚገባ አይደለም።

verses.en: Many will say to me in that day, Master, Master, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ብዙዎች። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ በስምህ ትንቢት አልተናገርንምን፥ በስምህስ አጋንንትን አላወጣንምን፥ በስምህስ ብዙ ተአምራትን አላደረግንምን? ይሉኛል።

verses.en: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜም። ከቶ አላወቅኋችሁም፤ እናንተ ዓመፀኞች፥ ከእኔ ራቁ ብዬ እመሰክርባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
verses.am: ስለዚህ ይህን ቃሌን ሰምቶ የሚያደርገው ሁሉ ቤቱን በዓለት ላይ የሠራ ልባም ሰውን ይመስላል።

verses.en: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.am: ዝናብም ወረደ ጎርፍም መጣ ነፋስም ነፈሰ ያንም ቤት ገፋው፥ በዓለት ላይም ስለ ተመሠረተ አልወደቀም።

verses.en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
verses.am: ይህንም ቃሌን ሰምቶ የማያደርገው ሰው ሁሉ ቤቱን በአሸዋ ላይ የሠራ ሰነፍ ሰውን ይመስላል።

verses.en: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
verses.am: ዝናብም ወረደ ጎርፍም መጣ ነፋስም ነፈሰ ያንም ቤት መታው፥ ወደቀም፥ አወዳደቁም ታላቅ ሆነ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Yahushua had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ነገር በጨረሰ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ፤ እንደ ጻፎቻቸው ሳይሆን

verses.en: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.am: እንደ ባለ ሥልጣን ያስተምራቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.am: ከተራራም በወረደ ጊዜ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Master, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ለምጻም ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ብትወድስ ልታነጻኝ ትችላለህ እያለ ሰገደለት።

verses.en: And Yahushua put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.am: እጁንም ዘርግቶ ዳሰሰውና። እወዳለሁ፥ ንጻ አለው። ወዲያውም ለምጹ ነጻ።

verses.en: And Yahushua saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Mosheh commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ለማንም እንዳትናገር ተጠንቀቅ፥ ነገር ግን ሄደህ ራስህን ለካህን አሳይ፥ ለእነርሱም ምስክር እንዲሆን ሙሴ ያዘዘውን መባ አቅርብ አለው።

verses.en: And when Yahushua was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
verses.am: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም በገባ ጊዜ የመቶ አለቃ ወደ እርሱ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥

verses.en: And saying, Master, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
verses.am: ብላቴናዬ ሽባ ሆኖ እጅግ እየተሣቀየ በቤት ተኝቶአል ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.en: And Yahushua saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔ መጥቼ እፈውሰዋለሁ አለው።

verses.en: The centurion answered and said, Master, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቃውም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በቤቴ ጣራ ከታች ልትገባ አይገባኝም፤ ነገር ግን ቃል ብቻ ተናገር፥ ብላቴናዬም ይፈወሳል።

verses.en: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ ለሌሎች ተገዥ ነኝና፥ ከእኔም በታች ጭፍራ አለኝ፤ አንዱንም። ሂድ ብለው ይሄዳል፥ ሌላውንም። ና ብለው ይመጣል፥ ባሪያዬንም። ይህን አድርግ ብለው ያደርጋል አለው።

verses.en: When Yahushua heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yisra'el.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ ተደነቀና ለተከተሉት እንዲህ አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በእስራኤል እንኳ እንዲህ ያለ ትልቅ እምነት አላገኘሁም።

verses.en: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Yitschaq, and Ya'aqob, in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁም፥ ብዙዎች ከምሥራቅና ከምዕራብ ይመጣሉ ከአብርሃምና ከይስሐቅ ከያዕቆብም ጋር በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ይቀመጣሉ፤

verses.en: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.am: የመንግሥት ልጆች ግን በውጭ ወደ አለው ጨለማ ይጣላሉ፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Yahushua said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ለመቶ አለቃ። ሂድና እንዳመንህ ይሁንልህ አለው። ብላቴናውም በዚያች ሰዓት ተፈወሰ።

verses.en: And when Yahushua was come into Kepha's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ጴጥሮስ ቤት ገብቶ አማቱን በንዳድ ታማ ተኝታ አያት፤

verses.en: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
verses.am: እጅዋንም ዳሰሰ፥ ንዳዱም ለቀቃት፤ ተነሥታም አገለገለቻቸው።

verses.en: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ብዙ ሰዎች ሲከቡት አይቶ ወደ ማዶ እንዲሻገሩ አዘዘ።

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ብዙ ሰዎች ሲከቡት አይቶ ወደ ማዶ እንዲሻገሩ አዘዘ።

verses.en: Now when Yahushua saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
verses.am: አንድ ጻፊም ቀርቦ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ወደምትሄድበት ሁሉ እከተልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ለቀበሮዎች ጉድጓድ ለሰማይም ወፎች መሳፈሪያ አላቸው፥ ለሰው ልጅ ግን ራሱን የሚያስጠጋበት የለውም አለው።

verses.en: And Yahushua saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሌላው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አስቀድሜ እንድሄድ አባቴን እንድቀብር ፍቀድልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And another of his disciples said unto him, Master, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ተከተለኝ፥ ሙታናቸውንም እንዲቀብሩ ሙታንን ተዋቸው አለው።

verses.en: But Yahushua said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
verses.am: ወደ ታንኳም ሲገባ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ማዕበሉ ታንኳይቱን እስኪደፍናት ድረስ በባሕር ታላቅ መናወጥ ሆነ፤ እርሱ ግን ተኝቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አድነን፥ ጠፋን እያሉ አስነሡት።

verses.en: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, save us: we perish.
verses.am: እርሱም። እናንተ እምነት የጎደላችሁ፥ ስለ ምን ትፈራላችሁ? አላቸው፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ተነሥቶ ነፋሱንና ባሕሩን ገሠጸ፥ ታላቅ ጸጥታም ሆነ።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም። ነፋሳትና ባሕርስ ስንኳ የሚታዘዙለት፥ ይህ እንዴት ያለ ሰው ነው? እያሉ ተደነቁ።

verses.en: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
verses.am: ወደ ማዶም ወደ ጌርጋሴኖን አገር በመጣ ጊዜ፥ አጋንንት ያደሩባቸው ሁለት ሰዎች ከመቃብር ወጥተው ተገናኙት፤ እነርሱም ሰው በዚያ መንገድ ማለፍ እስኪሳነው ድረስ እጅግ ክፉዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
verses.am: እነሆም። ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለን? ጊዜው ሳይደርስ ልትሣቅየን ወደዚህ መጣህን? እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.en: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Yahushua, thou Son of YAHUAH? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ርቆ የብዙ እሪያ መንጋ ይሰማራ ነበር።

verses.en: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
verses.am: አጋንንቱም። ታወጣንስ እንደሆንህ፥ ወደ እሪያው መንጋ ስደደን ብለው ለመኑት። ሂዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወጥተው ወደ እሪያዎቹ ሄዱና ገቡ፤ እነሆም፥ የእሪያዎቹ መንጋ ሁሉ ከአፋፉ ወደ ባሕር እየተጣደፉ ሮጡ በውኃም ውስጥ ሞቱ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.am: እረኞችም ሸሹ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም ሄደው ነገሩን ሁሉ አጋንንትም በአደሩባቸው የሆነውን አወሩ።

verses.en: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከተማው ሁሉ ኢየሱስን ሊገናኝ ወጣ፥ ባዩትም ጊዜ ከአገራቸው እንዲሄድላቸው ለመኑት።

verses.en: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Yahushua: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
verses.am: በታንኳም ገብቶ ተሻገረና ወደ ገዛ ከተማው መጣ።

verses.en: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Yahushua seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በአልጋ የተኛ ሽባ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ። ኢየሱስም እምነታቸውን አይቶ ሽባውን። አንተ ልጅ፥ አይዞህ፥ ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ አለው።

verses.en: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከጻፎቹ አንዳንዱ በልባቸው። ይህስ ይሳደባል አሉ።

verses.en: And Yahushua knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አሳባቸውን አውቆ እንዲህ አለ። ስለ ምን በልባችሁ ክፉ ታስባላችሁ?

verses.en: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.am: ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ ከማለት ወይስ። ተነሣና ሂድ ከማለት ማናቸው ይቀላል?

verses.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በምድር ላይ ኃጢአትን ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ ለሰው ልጅ ሥልጣን እንዳለው እንድታውቁ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ሽባውን። ተነሣ፤ አልጋህን ተሸከምና ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.am: ተነሥቶም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified YAHUAH, which had given such power unto men.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም አይተው ተደነቁ፥ ለሰውም እንዲህ ያለ ሥልጣን የሰጠ እግዚአብሔርን አከበሩ።

verses.en: And as Yahushua passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Mattithyahu, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ አልፎ በመቅረጫው ተቀምጦ የነበረ ማቴዎስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው አየና። ተከተለኝ አለው። ተነሥቶም ተከተለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as Yahushua sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
verses.am: በቤቱም በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ እነሆ፥ ብዙ ቀራጮችና ኃጢአተኞች መጥተው ከኢየሱስና ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር አብረው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም አይተው ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። መምህራችሁ ከቀራጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር አብሮ ስለ ምን ይበላል? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: But when Yahushua heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ። ሕመምተኞች እንጂ ባለ ጤናዎች ባለ መድኃኒት አያስፈልጋቸውም፤

verses.en: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሄዳችሁ። ምሕረትን እወዳለሁ መሥዋዕትንም አይደለም ያለው ምን እንደ ሆነ ተማሩ፤ ኃጢአተኞችን ወደ ንስሐ እንጂ ጻድቃንን ልጠራ አልመጣሁምና አላቸው።

verses.en: Then came to him the disciples of Yohanan, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርት ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። እኛና ፈሪሳውያን፥ ብዙ ጊዜ የምንጦመው፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ግን የማይጦሙት ስለ ምንድር ነው? አሉት።

verses.en: And Yahushua said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። ሚዜዎች ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሊያዝኑ ይችላሉን? ነገር ግን ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ የሚወሰድበት ወራት ይመጣል፥ በዚያ ጊዜም ይጦማሉ።

verses.en: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
verses.am: በአረጀ ልብስ አዲስ እራፊ የሚያኖር የለም፤ መጣፊያው ልብሱን ይቦጭቀዋልና፥ መቀደዱም የባሰ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
verses.am: በአረጀ አቁማዳ አዲስ የወይን ጠጅ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን፥ አቁማዳው ይፈነዳል፥ የወይን ጠጁም ይፈሳል አቁማዳውም ይጠፋል፤ ነገር ግን አዲሱን የወይን ጠጅ በአዲስ አቁማዳ ያኖረዋል፥ ሁለቱም ይጠባበቃሉ።

verses.en: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.am: ይህንም ሲነግራቸው፥ አንድ መኰንን መጥቶ። ልጄ አሁን ሞተች፤ ነገር ግን መጥተህ እጅህን ጫንባት፥ በሕይወትም ትኖራለች እያለ ሰገደለት።

verses.en: And Yahushua arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ተነሥቶ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተከተለው።

verses.en: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ጀምሮ ደም የሚፈስሳት ሴት በኋላው ቀርባ የልብሱን ጫፍ ዳሰሰች፤

verses.en: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
verses.am: በልብዋ። ልብሱን ብቻ የዳሰስሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ እድናለሁ ትል ነበረችና።

verses.en: But Yahushua turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዘወር ብሎ አያትና። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አይዞሽ፤ እምነትሽ አድኖሻል አላት። ሴቲቱም ከዚያች ሰዓት ጀምራ ዳነች።

verses.en: And when Yahushua came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ መኰንኑ ቤት በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ እምቢልተኞችንና የሚንጫጫውን ሕዝብ አይቶ።

verses.en: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.am: ብላቴናይቱ ተኝታለች እንጂ አልሞተችምና ፈቀቅ በሉ አላቸው። በጣምም ሳቁበት።

verses.en: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
verses.am: ሕዝቡን ግን ከአስወጡ በኋላ ገብቶ እጅዋን ያዛት፥ ብላቴናይቱም ተነሣች።

verses.en: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
verses.am: ያም ዝና ወደዚያ አገር ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.en: And when Yahushua departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of Dawid, have mercy on us.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ ሲያልፍ ሁለት ዕውሮች። የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማረን ብለው እየጮሁ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Yahushua saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Master.
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም በገባ ጊዜ ዕውሮቹ ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፥ ኢየሱስም። ይህን ማድረግ እንድችል ታምናላችሁን? አላቸው። አዎን፥ ጌታ ሆይ አሉት።

verses.en: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ። እንደ እምነታችሁ ይሁንላችሁ ብሎ ዓይኖቻቸውን ዳሰሰ።

verses.en: And their eyes were opened; and Yahushua straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
verses.am: ዓይኖቻቸውም ተከፈቱ።

verses.en: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ማንም እንዳያውቅ ተጠንቀቁ ብሎ በብርቱ አዘዛቸው። እነርሱ ግን ወጥተው በዚያ አገር ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ አወሩ።

verses.en: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሲወጡ እነሆ፥ ጋኔን ያደረበትን ዲዳ ሰው ወደ እርሱ አመጡ።

verses.en: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Yisra'el.
verses.am: ጋኔኑንም ካወጣው በኋላ ዲዳው ተናገረ። ሕዝቡም። እንዲህ ያለ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ከቶ አልታየም እያሉ ተደነቁ።

verses.en: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያን ግን። በአጋንንት አለቃ አጋንንትን ያወጣል አሉ።

verses.en: And Yahushua went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በምኩራቦቻቸው እያስተማረ፥ የመንግሥትንም ወንጌል እየሰበከ፥ በሕዝብም ያለውን ደዌና ሕማም ሁሉ እየፈወሰ፥ በከተማዎችና በመንደሮች ሁሉ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.en: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
verses.am: ብዙ ሕዝብም ባየ ጊዜ፥ እረኛ እንደ ሌላቸው በጎች ተጨንቀው ተጥለውም ነበርና አዘነላቸው።

verses.en: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። መከሩስ ብዙ ነው፥ ሠራተኞች ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸው፤

verses.en: Pray ye therefore the Master of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የመከሩን ጌታ ወደ መከሩ ሠራተኞች እንዲልክ ለምኑት አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ፥ እንዲያወጡአቸው በርኩሳን መናፍስት ላይ ደዌንና ሕማምንም ሁሉ እንዲፈውሱ ሥልጣን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Kepha, and Andrew his brother; Ya'aqob the son of Zebedee, and Yohanan his brother;
verses.am: የአሥራ ሁለቱም ሐዋርያት ስም ይህ ነው፤ መጀመሪያው ጴጥሮስ የተባለው ስምዖን ወንድሙ እንድርያስም፥ የዘብዴዎስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም ወንድሙ ዮሐንስም፥

verses.en: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Mattithyahu the publican; Ya'aqob the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
verses.am: ፊልጶስም በርተሎሜዎስም፥ ቶማስም ቀራጩ ማቴዎስም፥ የእልፍዮስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም ታዴዎስም የተባለው ልብድዮስ፥

verses.en: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.am: ቀነናዊውም ስምዖን ደግሞም አሳልፎ የሰጠው የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ።

verses.en: These twelve Yahushua sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the nations, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
verses.am: እነዚህን አሥራ ሁለቱን ኢየሱስ ላካቸው፥ አዘዛቸውም፥ እንዲህም አለ። በአሕዛብ መንገድ አትሂዱ፥ ወደ ሳምራውያንም ከተማ አትግቡ፤

verses.en: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ይልቅስ የእስራኤል ቤት ወደሚሆኑ ወደ ጠፉት በጎች ሂዱ እንጂ።

verses.en: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.am: ሄዳችሁም። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለች ብላችሁ ስበኩ።

verses.en: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
verses.am: ድውዮችን ፈውሱ፤ ሙታንን አስነሡ፤ ለምጻሞችን አንጹ፤ አጋንንትን አውጡ፤ በከንቱ ተቀበላችሁ፥ በከንቱ ስጡ።

verses.en: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
verses.am: ወርቅ ወይም ብር ወይም ናስ በመቀነታችሁ፥

verses.en: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
verses.am: ወይም ለመንገድ ከረጢት ወይም ሁለት እጀ ጠባብ ወይም ጫማ ወይም በትር አታግኙ፤ ለሠራተኛ ምግቡ ይገባዋልና።

verses.en: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
verses.am: በምትገቡባትም በማናቸይቱም ከተማ ወይም መንደር፥ በዚያ የሚገባው ማን እንደ ሆነ በጥንቃቄ መርምሩ፤ እስክትወጡም ድረስ በዚያ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም ስትገቡ ሰላምታ ስጡ፤

verses.en: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.am: ቤቱም የሚገባው ቢሆን ሰላማችሁ ይድረስለት፤ ባይገባው ግን ሰላማችሁ ይመለስላችሁ።

verses.en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.am: ከማይቀበላችሁም ቃላችሁንም ከማይሰሙ ሁሉ፥ ከዚያ ቤት ወይም ከዚያች ከተማ ስትወጡ የእግራችሁን ትቢያ አራግፉ።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በፍርድ ቀን ከዚያች ከተማ ይልቅ ለሰዶምና ለገሞራ አገር ይቀልላቸዋል።

verses.en: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ እንደ በጎች በተኵላዎች መካከል እልካችኋለሁ፤ ስለዚህ እንደ እባብ ልባሞች እንደ ርግብም የዋሆች ሁኑ።

verses.en: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ ሸንጎ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ በምኩራቦቻቸውም ይገርፉአችኋልና ከሰዎች ተጠበቁ፤

verses.en: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the nations.
verses.am: ለእነርሱና ለአሕዛብም ምስክር እንዲሆን፥ ስለ እኔ ወደ ገዥዎች ወደ ነገሥታትም ትወሰዳላችሁ።

verses.en: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
verses.am: አሳልፈውም ሲሰጡአችሁ፥ የምትናገሩት በዚያች ሰዓት ይሰጣችኋልና እንዴት ወይስ ምን እንድትናገሩ አትጨነቁ፤

verses.en: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
verses.am: በእናንተ የሚናገር የአባታችሁ መንፈስ ነው እንጂ፥ የምትናገሩ እናንተ አይደላችሁምና።

verses.en: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.am: ወንድምም ወንድሙን፥ አባትም ልጁን ለሞት አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፥ ልጆችም በወላጆቻቸው ላይ ይነሣሉ ይገድሉአቸውማል።

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
verses.am: በሁሉም ስለ ስሜ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ፤ እስከ መጨረሻ የሚጸና ግን እርሱ ይድናል።

verses.en: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Yisra'el, till the Son of man be come.
verses.am: በአንዲቱ ከተማም መከራ ቢያሳዩአችሁ ወደ ሌላይቱ ሽሹ፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁና፥ የሰው ልጅ እስኪመጣ ድረስ የእስራኤልን ከተማዎች አትዘልቁም።

verses.en: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
verses.am: ደቀ መዝሙር ከመምህሩ፥ ባሪያም ከጌታው አይበልጥም።

verses.en: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
verses.am: ደቀ መዝሙር እንደ መምህሩ፥ ባሪያም እንደ ጌታው መሆኑ ይበቃዋል። ባለቤቱን ብዔል ዜቡል ካሉት፥ ቤተሰዎቹንማ እንዴት አብዝተው አይሉአቸው!

verses.en: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አትፍሩአቸው፤ የማይገለጥ የተከደነ፥ የማይታወቅም የተሰወረ ምንም የለምና።

verses.en: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
verses.am: በጨለማ የምነግራችሁን በብርሃን ተናገሩ፤ በጆሮም የምትሰሙትን በሰገነት ላይ ስበኩ።

verses.en: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.am: ሥጋንም የሚገድሉትን ነፍስን ግን መግደል የማይቻላቸውን አትፍሩ፤ ይልቅስ ነፍስንም ሥጋንም በገሃነም ሊያጠፋ የሚቻለውን ፍሩ።

verses.en: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
verses.am: ሁለት ድንቢጦች በአምስት ሳንቲም ይሸጡ የለምን? ከእነርሱም አንዲቱ ያለ አባታችሁ ፈቃድ በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም።

verses.en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.am: የእናንተስ የራሳችሁ ጠጉር ሁሉ እንኳ ተቈጥሮአል።

verses.en: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አትፍሩ ከብዙ ድንቢጦች እናንተ ትበልጣላችሁ።

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በሰው ፊት ለሚመሰክርልኝ ሁሉ እኔ ደግሞ በሰማያት ባለው በአባቴ ፊት እመሰክርለታለሁ፤

verses.en: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.am: በሰው ፊትም የሚክደኝን ሁሉ እኔ ደግሞ በሰማያት ባለው በአባቴ ፊት እክደዋለሁ።

verses.en: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ሰላምን ለማምጣት የመጣሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ ሰይፍን እንጂ ሰላምን ለማምጣት አልመጣሁም።

verses.en: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.am: ሰውን ከአባቱ፥ ሴት ልጅንም ከእናትዋ፥ ምራትንም ከአማትዋ እለያይ ዘንድ መጥቻለሁና፤

verses.en: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
verses.am: ለሰውም ቤተ ሰዎቹ ጠላቶች ይሆኑበታል።

verses.en: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.am: ከእኔ ይልቅ አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚወድ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም፤ ከእኔ ይልቅም ወንድ ልጁን ወይም ሴት ልጁን የሚወድ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም፤

verses.en: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.am: መስቀሉንም የማይዝ በኋላዬም የማይከተለኝ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም።

verses.en: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.am: ነፍሱን የሚያገኝ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም ስለ እኔ የሚያጠፋ ያገኛታል።

verses.en: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.am: እናንተን የሚቀበል እኔን ይቀበላል፥ እኔንም የሚቀበል የላከኝን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
verses.am: ነቢይን በነቢይ ስም የሚቀበል የነቢይን ዋጋ ይወስዳል፥ ጻድቅንም በጻድቅ ስም የሚቀበል የጻድቁን ዋጋ ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.am: ማንም ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ ለአንዱ ቀዝቃዛ ጽዋ ውኃ ብቻ በደቀ መዝሙር ስም የሚያጠጣ፥ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋው አይጠፋበትም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Yahushua had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ማዘዝ በፈጸመ ጊዜ በከተሞቻቸው ሊያስተምርና ሊሰብክ ከዚያ አለፈ።

verses.en: Now when Yohanan had heard in the prison the works of Messiah, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.am: ዮሐንስም በወህኒ ሳለ የክርስቶስን ሥራ ሰምቶ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለት ላከና።

verses.en: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
verses.am: የሚመጣው አንተ ነህን? ወይስ ሌላ እንጠብቅ? አለው።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto them, Go and shew Yohanan again those things which ye do hear and see:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ሄዳችሁ ያያችሁትን የሰማችሁትንም ለዮሐንስ አውሩለት፤

verses.en: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
verses.am: ዕውሮች ያያሉ አንካሶችም ይሄዳሉ፥ ለምጻሞችም ይነጻሉ ደንቆሮችም ይሰማሉ፥ ሙታንም ይነሣሉ

verses.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.am: ለድሆችም ወንጌል ይሰበካል፤ በእኔም የማይሰናከለው ሁሉ ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.en: And as they departed, Yahushua began to say unto the multitudes concerning Yohanan, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.am: እነዚያም ሲሄዱ ኢየሱስ ለሕዝቡ ስለ ዮሐንስ ሊናገር ጀመረ እንዲህም አለ። ምን ልታዩ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጣችሁ?

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
verses.am: ነፋስ የሚወዘውዘውን ሸምበቆን? ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ? ቀጭን ልብስ የለበሰ ሰውን? እነሆ፥ ቀጭን ልብስ የለበሱ በነገሥታት ቤት አሉ።

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
verses.am: ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ? ነቢይን? አዎን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከነቢይም የሚበልጠውን።

verses.en: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ መንገድህን በፊትህ የሚጠርግ መልክተኛዬን በፊትህ እልካለሁ

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than Yohanan the Immerser: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.am: ተብሎ የተጻፈለት ይህ ነውና። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሴቶች ከተወለዱት መካከል ከመጥምቁ ዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ አልተነሣም፤ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ግን ከሁሉ የሚያንሰው ይበልጠዋል።

verses.en: And from the days of Yohanan the Immerser until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.am: ከመጥምቁም ከዮሐንስ ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ትገፋለች፥ ግፈኞችም ይናጠቋታል።

verses.en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until Yohanan.
verses.am: ነቢያት ሁሉና ሕጉ እስከ ዮሐንስ ድረስ ትንቢት ተናገሩ፤

verses.en: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
verses.am: ልትቀበሉትስ ብትወዱ፥ ይመጣ ዘንድ ያለው ኤልያስ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.am: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.en: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህን ትውልድ በምን እመስለዋለሁ? በገበያ የሚቀመጡትን ልጆች ይመስላሉ፥ እነርሱም ባልንጀሮቻቸውን እየጠሩ።

verses.en: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
verses.am: እንቢልታ ነፋንላችሁ ዘፈንም አልዘፈናችሁም ሙሾ አወጣንላችሁ ዋይ ዋይም አላላችሁም ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: For Yohanan came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ ሳይበላና ሳይጠጣ መጣ፥ እነርሱም። ጋኔን አለበት አሉት።

verses.en: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ እየበላና እየጠጣ መጣ፥ እነርሱም። እነሆ፥ በላተኛና የወይን ጠጅ ጠጭ፥ የቀራጮችና የኃጢአተኞች ወዳጅ ይሉታል። ጥበብም በልጆችዋ ጸደቀች።

verses.en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የሚበዙ ተአምራት የተደረገባቸውን ከተማዎች ንስሐ ስላልገቡ ሊነቅፋቸው ጀመረ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.am: ወዮልሽ ኮራዚ፤ ወዮልሽ ቤተ ሳይዳ፤ በእናንተ የተደረገው ተአምራት በጢሮስና በሲዶና ተደርጎ ቢሆን፥ ማቅ ለብሰው አመድም ነስንሰው ከብዙ ጊዜ በፊት ንስሐ በገቡ ነበርና።

verses.en: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በፍርድ ቀን ከእናንተ ይልቅ ለጢሮስና ለሲዶና ይቀልላቸዋል።

verses.en: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
verses.am: አንቺም ቅፍርናሆም፥ እስከ ሰማይ ከፍ አልሽን? ወደ ሲኦል ትወርጃለሽ፤ በአንቺ የተደረገው ተአምራት በሰዶም ተደርጎ ቢሆን፥ እስከ ዛሬ በኖረች ነበርና።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በፍርድ ቀን ከአንቺ ይልቅ ለሰዶም አገር ይቀልላታል።

verses.en: At that time Yahushua answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Master of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። አባት ሆይ፥ የሰማይና የምድር ጌታ፥ ይህን ከጥበበኞችና ከአስተዋዮች ሰውረህ ለሕፃናት ስለ ገለጥህላቸው አመሰግንሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.am: አዎን፥ አባት ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህ በፊትህ እንዲህ ሆኖአልና።

verses.en: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
verses.am: ሁሉ ከአባቴ ዘንድ ተሰጥቶኛል፤ ከአብ በቀር ወልድን የሚያውቅ የለም፥ ከወልድም በቀር ወልድም ሊገለጥለት ከሚፈቅድ በቀር አብን የሚያውቅ የለም።

verses.en: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.am: እናንተ ደካሞች ሸክማችሁ የከበደ ሁሉ፥ ወደ እኔ ኑ፥ እኔም አሳርፋችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.am: ቀንበሬን በላያችሁ ተሸከሙ ከእኔም ተማሩ፥ እኔ የዋህ በልቤም ትሑት ነኝና፥ ለነፍሳችሁም ዕረፍት ታገኛላችሁ፤

verses.en: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
verses.am: ቀንበሬ ልዝብ ሸክሜም ቀሊል ነውና።

verses.en: At that time Yahushua went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በሰንበት ቀን በእርሻ መካከል አለፈ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ተራቡና እሸት ይቀጥፉ ይበሉም ጀመር።

verses.en: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም አይተው። እነሆ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህ በሰንበት ማድረግ ያልተፈቀደውን ያደርጋሉ አሉት።

verses.en: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what Dawid did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
How he entered into the house of YAHUAH, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው። ዳዊትና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት በተራቡ ጊዜ፥ እርሱ ያደረገውን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ገባ ካህናትም ብቻ እንጂ እርሱና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ሊበሉት ያልተፈቀደውን የመሥዋዕቱን ኅብስት እንደ በላ አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.en: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
verses.am: ካህናትም በሰንበት በመቅደስ ሰንበትን እንዲያረክሱ ኃጢአትም እንዳይሆንባቸው በሕጉ አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.en: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከመቅደስ የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.en: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.am: ምሕረትን እወዳለሁ መሥዋዕትንም አይደለም ያለው ምን እንደሆነ ብታውቁስ ኃጢአት የሌለባቸውን ባልኰነናችሁም ነበር።

verses.en: For the Son of man is Master even of the sabbath day.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ የሰንበት ጌታ ነውና።

verses.en: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
verses.am: ከዚያም አልፎ ወደ ምኩራባቸው ገባ።

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ እጁ የሰለለች ሰው ነበረ፤ ይከሱትም ዘንድ። በሰንበት መፈወስ ተፈቅዶአልን? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ከእናንተ አንድ በግ ያለው በሰንበት በጉድጓድ ቢወድቅበት፥ ይዞ የማያወጣው ሰው ማን ነው?

verses.en: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሰው ከበግ ይልቅ እንደምን አይበልጥም! ስለዚህ በሰንበት መልካም መሥራት ተፈቅዶአል አላቸው።

verses.en: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ሰውየውን። እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው። ዘረጋትም፥ እንደ ሁለተኛይቱም ደህና ሆነች።

verses.en: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያን ግን ወጥተው እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያጠፉት ተማከሩበት።

verses.en: But when Yahushua knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አውቆ ከዚያ ፈቀቅ አለ። ብዙ ሰዎችም ተከተሉት፥ ሁሉንም ፈወሳቸው፥ እንዳይገልጡትም አዘዛቸው፤

verses.en: And charged them that they should not make him known:
verses.am: እነሆ የመረጥሁት ብላቴናዬ፥ ነፍሴ ደስ የተሰኘችበት ወዳጄ፤ መንፈሴን በእርሱ ላይ አኖራለሁ፥ ፍርድንም ለአሕዛብ ያወራል።

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.am: እነሆ የመረጥሁት ብላቴናዬ፥ ነፍሴ ደስ የተሰኘችበት ወዳጄ፤ መንፈሴን በእርሱ ላይ አኖራለሁ፥ ፍርድንም ለአሕዛብ ያወራል።

verses.en: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the nations.
verses.am: አይከራከርም አይጮህምም፥ ድምፁንም በአደባባይ የሚሰማ የለም።

verses.en: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
verses.am: ፍርድን ድል ለመንሣት እስኪያወጣ፥ የተቀጠቀጠን ሸምበቆ አይሰብርም የሚጤስን የጥዋፍ ክርም አያጠፋም።

verses.en: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.am: አሕዛብም በስሙ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: And in his name shall the nations trust.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ጋኔን ያደረበትን ዕውር ዲዳም ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ዕውሩም ዲዳውም እስኪያይና እስኪናገር ድረስ ፈወሰው።

verses.en: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ተገረሙና። እንጃ ይህ ሰው የዳዊት ልጅ ይሆንን? አሉ።

verses.en: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of Dawid?
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያን ግን ሰምተው። ይህ በብዔል ዜቡል በአጋንንት አለቃ ካልሆነ በቀር አጋንንትን አያወጣም አሉ።

verses.en: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን አሳባቸውን አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እርስ በርስዋ የምትለያይ መንግሥት ሁላ ትጠፋለች፥ እርስ በርሱ የሚለያይ ከተማም ሁሉ ወይም ቤት አይቆምም።

verses.en: And Yahushua knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
verses.am: ሰይጣንም ሰይጣንን የሚያወጣ ከሆነ፥ እርስ በርሱ ተለያየ፥ እንግዲህ መንግሥቱ እንዴት ትቆማለች?

verses.en: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
verses.am: እኔስ በብዔል ዜቡል አጋንንትን የማወጣ ከሆንሁ፥ ልጆቻችሁ በማን ያወጡአቸዋል? ስለዚህ እነርሱ ፈራጆች ይሆኑባችኋል።

verses.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ አጋንንትን የማወጣ ከሆንሁ፥ እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ወደ እናንተ ደርሳለች።

verses.en: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of YAHUAH, then the kingdom of YAHUAH is come unto you.
verses.am: ወይስ ሰው አስቀድሞ ኃይለኛውን ሳያስር ወደ ኃይለኛው ቤት ገብቶ እቃውን ሊነጥቀው እንዴት ይችላል? ከዚያም ወዲያ ቤቱን ይበዘብዛል።

verses.en: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ያልሆነ ይቃወመኛል፥ ከእኔ ጋርም የማያከማች ይበትናል።

verses.en: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ ኃጢአትና ስድብ ሁሉ ለሰዎች ይሰረይላቸዋል፥ ነገር ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስን ለሰደበ አይሰረይለትም።

verses.en: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Set-apart Spirit shall not be forgiven unto men.
verses.am: በሰው ልጅ ላይ ቃል የሚናገር ሁሉ ይሰረይለታል፤ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ላይ ግን የሚናገር ሁሉ በዚህ ዓለም ቢሆን ወይም በሚመጣው አይሰረይለትም።

verses.en: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Set-apart Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
verses.am: ዛፍ ከፍሬዋ ትታወቃለችና ዛፍዋን መልካም፥ ፍሬዋንም መልካም አድርጉ፥ ወይም ዛፍዋን ክፉ ፍሬዋንም ክፉ አድርጉ።

verses.en: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
verses.am: እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ክፉዎች ስትሆኑ መልካም ለመናገር እንዴት ትችላላችሁ? በልብ ሞልቶ ከተረፈው አፍ ይናገራልና።

verses.en: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
verses.am: መልካም ሰው ከልቡ መልካም መዝገብ መልካም ነገርን ያወጣል፥ ክፉ ሰውም ከክፉ መዝገብ ክፉ ነገርን ያወጣል።

verses.en: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
verses.am: እኔ እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰዎች ስለሚናገሩት ስለ ከንቱ ነገር ሁሉ በፍርድ ቀን መልስ ይሰጡበታል፤

verses.en: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
verses.am: ከቃልህ የተነሣ ትጸድቃለህና ከቃልህም የተነሣ ትኰነናለህ።

verses.en: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ከጻፎችና ከፈሪሳውያን አንዳንዶቹ መለሱና። መምህር ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ምልክት እንድናይ እንወዳለን አሉ።

verses.en: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ክፉና አመንዝራ ትውልድ ምልክት ይሻል፥ ከነቢዩም ከዮናስ ምልክት በቀር ምልክት አይሰጠውም።

verses.en: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
verses.am: ዮናስ በዓሣ አንባሪ ሆድ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት እንደ ነበረ፥ እንዲሁ የሰው ልጅ በምድር ልብ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት ይኖራል።

verses.en: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.am: የነነዌ ሰዎች በፍርድ ቀን ከዚህ ትውልድ ጋር ተነሥተው ይፈርዱበታል፤ በዮናስ ስብከት ንስሐ ገብተዋልና፥ እነሆም፥ ከዮናስ የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.en: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.am: ንግሥተ ዓዜብ በፍርድ ቀን ከዚህ ትውልድ ጋር ተነሥታ ትፈርድበታለች፤ የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ ለመስማት ከምድር ዳር መጥታለችና፥ እነሆም፥ ከሰሎሞን የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Shelomoh; and, behold, a greater than Shelomoh is here.
verses.am: ርኩስ መንፈስ ግን ከሰው በወጣ ጊዜ፥ ዕረፍት እየፈለገ ውኃ በሌለበት ቦታ ያልፋል፥ አያገኝምም።

verses.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም። ወደ ወጣሁበት ቤቴ እመለሳለሁ ይላል፤ ቢመጣም ባዶ ሆኖ ተጠርጎና አጊጦ ያገኘዋል።

verses.en: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያ ይሄድና ከእርሱ የከፉትን ሰባት ሌሎችን አጋንንት ከእርሱ ጋር ይወስዳል፥ ገብተውም በዚያ ይኖራሉ፤ ለዚያም ሰው ከፊተኛው ይልቅ የኋለኛው ይብስበታል። ለዚህ ክፉ ትውልድ ደግሞ እንዲሁ ይሆንበታል።

verses.en: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
verses.am: ገናም ለሕዝቡ ሲናገር፥ እነሆ፥ እናቱና ወንድሞቹ ሊነጋገሩት ፈልገው በውጭ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
verses.am: አንዱም። እነሆ፥ እናትህና ወንድሞችህ ሊነጋገሩህ ፈልገው በውጭ ቆመዋል አለው።

verses.en: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ለነገረው መልሶ። እናቴ ማን ናት? ወንድሞቼስ እነማን ናቸው? አለው።

verses.en: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
verses.am: እጁንም ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ዘርግቶ። እነሆ እናቴና ወንድሞቼ፤

verses.en: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.am: በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ፥ እርሱ ወንድሜ እኅቴም እናቴም ነውና አለ።

verses.en: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
The same day went Yahushua out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን ኢየሱስ ከቤት ወጥቶ በባሕር አጠገብ ተቀመጠ፤

verses.en: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.am: እርሱም በታንኳ ገብቶ እስኪቀመጥ ድረስ ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በወደቡ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
